title: Grateful Dead Live at Glens Falls Civic Center on 1982-04-14
lineage: Master Cassette > Nakamichi Dragon (Modified by Stephen Sank) with Dolby B > HHB CDR 830plus > EAC > Sound Forge 5.0 (tape flip splice) > CD Wave Editor 1.71 > WAV > SHN,  or > FLAC
source: Audience Recording: 2 Sennheiser MD421's > Sony TC-D5M 10th row (sec 102 row J seat 3) 7-8' stand, Maxell MX90 cassettes with Dolby B

ai_review.summary: Audience‑sourced recording with clear sound captures a high‑energy show highlighted by a stellar Deep Elem Blues and an inspired China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider sequence.
ai_review.review: The audience tape is surprisingly clean, preserving the crowd’s excitement while delivering enough detail to enjoy Jerry’s aggressive vocals on Big River and his fluid, bluegrass‑inflected solos. The performance shines on Deep Elem Blues, China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider and a dreamy Lazy Lightning → Supplication stretch, though Bob Weir slips on the opening lyrics of one early number.

ai_rating.rationale: Four detailed reviews average 4.25 stars; most praise both musical performance and recording quality, with only minor performance hiccups noted.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear enough for an audience source, captures crowd excitement; no major drop‑outs or muffling reported, though not as pristine as a soundboard.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
poor_songs: Bob Weir’s opening of an early song (lyrical slip)
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set praised for tight playing and strong vocals; second half builds into high‑energy jams with extended improvisations and a seamless flow through China Cat Sunflower into I Know You Rider.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Aggressive vocal on Big River, percussive licks, bluegrass run, heavy and fluid soloing; described as masterful and emotive throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Bob: Early lyrical slip noted but overall mighty fine playing and great contribution to jams later in the set.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent’s jazzy space segment around Playin' in the Band highlighted as a dreamy moment.
